history.body: Hi, I came across the Pearl Residences ad. We’re looking to upgrade from our rental sometime this year. What’s the project like?

Pearl Residences is a freehold condominium in Seberang Jaya. Phase 1 homes are 900 sq. ft. with 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a balcony—room to spread out as you move up from renting. One important timing point: Phase 1 is expected to be completed in Q4 2029, so it won’t be ready to move into this year. Are you hoping to buy this year and move later, or do you need a home to move into this year?
We don’t need to move this year; we’re hoping to buy within the next year if we find the right place. So we’d be planning ahead for the Q4 2029 completion.

That gives you time to plan around the expected Q4 2029 completion. Pearl Residences’ freehold 900 sq. ft. homes have 3 bedrooms and a balcony, which may offer a meaningful step up from renting. A viewing could help you judge whether the layout feels right for you—would you like to arrange a visit?

Q4 2029 does feel quite far, and we’re not in a rush to move. Our rental feels small with our little one, so I’d want to understand whether the layout would give us more usable space before planning a visit.

That’s fair—Q4 2029 is a long way off, so it makes sense to check the layout suits your family before planning a visit. The 900 sq. ft. concept has an open-plan living, dining and kitchen area, avoids a long internal corridor, and includes a small storage area. That may help make the shared space feel more connected, with three bedrooms for separation. Exact furniture fit should be checked against the approved plan. What feels most cramped in your rental—the living area, storage, or bedroom space?
Mostly the living area. It’s a small two-bedroom rental, and our little one’s things make the shared space feel crowded.

That makes sense—if the living area is where you feel the squeeze, I’d focus on how the shared space works, not just the bedroom count. The open-plan living, dining and kitchen area avoids a long internal corridor, and there’s a small storage area; those may help with flow and everyday belongings. A viewing would let you judge the layout for yourself. Would you like me to help arrange one?
It could be worth looking at together, especially to compare the shared space with our rental. I’d want to discuss it with my partner first, though, so I’m not ready to arrange a visit just yet.

Absolutely—makes sense to talk it through with your partner first, especially with Q4 2029 still some way off. No need to arrange anything now; if you both decide it’s worth seeing, I can help with the next step.
